blocks.content: In this project, you'll create a simple yet engaging game called Rock, Paper, Scissors.
If you're unfamiliar with the rules, here's how the game works:

items: This game is played between two players.
Each player chooses one of the following options: rock, paper, or scissors.
If both players choose the same option, it's a draw.

blocks.content: If the players choose different options, one will win, and the other will lose. Next, let's see the winning rules.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
